Anya (Design): uploaded new frames to Figma — compact roles accordion, invite CTA variant B, SSO enforcement toggle copy. https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/roles-accordion :eyes:
Matt (PM): saw it, nice. Quick Q — for the SSO toggle, should copy read "Require SSO for new members" or "Enforce SSO for all members"? The latter sounds scarier.
Anya (Design): leaning "Require SSO for new members" to avoid surprise for org admins. We can add a tooltip "Existing members are unaffected".
Jun (Eng): implementation heads-up: if we show per-role collapsed state we can avoid rendering the whole matrix. Keyboard nav needs arrow-up/down + enter to expand. Also need aria-expanded on the accordion headers.
Olivia (Accessibility): agree on aria-expanded. Color contrast for the focus ring on collapsed headers is low at #a3d2ff on white. Suggest #0b62a4 or use 3px outline fallback.
Anya (Design): noted — will update to #0b62a4. Also adding a visual cue for selected role (striped left border) — cc @Jun for CSS approach.
Jun (Eng): striped border fine. For screen readers we'll add `role="button" tabindex="0"` and handle space/enter. Also suggest setting `aria-controls` to the matrix id.
Kai (Research): small UX ask re audit log: when you click "Jump to event" from a role row, should we open the audit panel anchored to that event and highlight change for 3s? Users expected context — highlighting helps.
Matt (PM): yes, highlight + auto-scroll into view sounds good. Edge-case: if event is older than retention, show toast "Event unavailable".
Olivia (Accessibility): make sure highlight uses motion-reduced styles for users with `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Anya (Design): copy tweak for invite CTA: current "Invite team" -> propose "Invite teammates" and secondary "Invite with SSO" when SSO required. Thoughts?
Matt (PM): "Invite teammates" is friendlier. For the SSO variant maybe just an inline badge "SSO enforced" instead of a separate CTA.
Jun (Eng): inline badge much easier. If org requires SSO, disable the plain invite button and show badge + tooltip.
ui-proto-bot: Storybook preview for the accordion and focus states is up: https://staging.redwood.dev/storybook/roles-accordion-1900001234
Matt (PM): awesome. Can design update the figma with the new hex and the tooltip copy? If so I'll flag for next sprint.
Anya (Design): will update figma + add a11y notes. Targeting EOD for mock and Monday for handoff.
Jun (Eng): I'll pair with Olivia on keyboard tests next week.
Olivia (Accessibility): happy to. I'll draft test cases: focus order, screen reader labels, reduced motion, contrast.
Matt (PM): thanks team — summary: change SSO copy to "Require SSO for new members", update focus color to #0b62a4, implement aria attributes, audit-log highlight + toast, invite CTA -> "Invite teammates" with inline SSO badge. Action owners: Anya (design), Jun (eng), Olivia (a11y). :thumbsup:
